description: This file defines a Fragment class 'DashboardFragment' which hosts a full-screen WebView that loads a specific HTML page from app assets. It configures WebView settings for local asset rendering and TV remote navigation, and handles key events to pass DPAD keys to the WebView for interaction within a smart home TV interface.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that hosts a WebView for displaying a local HTML page, with configuration suited for TV remote interaction and local asset loading.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the WebView with appropriate settings, focus, keys handling, and loads the local HTML page.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of DashboardFragment.
